data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F for the period ended June 30, 2026 shows positions in AXR and PLBC.

One recent signal: AXR reported Q2 2026 revenue of $6.1M versus $17.9M a year earlier, down 66.1% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6207/000110465926107084/0001104659-26-107084-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot? Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
